## Highlights since 0.11.0

- **No more flashes when opening files.** A file now opens straight into the view it will stay in. Markdown and HTML previews show a page-shaped placeholder instead of their source, text no longer rewraps once the fonts arrive, and a LaTeX file with comments shows its comment margin from the first frame.
- **Smoother tab dragging.** Dragging a tab to another panel follows the pointer smoothly, and panels lay out once when they come to rest.
- **A formatting toolbar in Markdown source mode.** Selecting text in the Markdown source editor shows the same toolbar as the visual editor: block type, bold, italic, links, inline math and more, written as Markdown.

## Notable fixes

- Footnote controls line up with the note's first line, + adds a block below the last block, and clicking beside a footnote puts the cursor in its text.
- Menus opened from the selection toolbar appear above the toolbar instead of under it.
- The Terminal panel no longer opens with a hint line, and moving it no longer prints the prompt twice.
- Jumping from the source to the PDF works for projects inside a symlinked folder.
